## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change and the affected plugin.

## Validation

- [ ] Clean Release build completed
- [ ] Complete affected CTest suite passed
- [ ] Live D2R validation completed, or explicitly marked not performed
- [ ] Compatibility guards fail open on mismatch

## Tracking

- [ ] Affected plugin `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] New/changed RVAs, signatures, layouts, hashes, and native contracts documented
- [ ] No game binaries, build output, logs, backups, saves, or credentials included
